name: Matzlfangen
summary: Bavarian 4-player point-trick game where teams try to score 66+ points and to capture the trump Ten (Matzl).
rules_text: Played with 32 German-suited cards, 4 players each dealt 8 cards. Last card of dealer determines trump suit unless higher contract overrides. Bidding clockwise from forehand: each player may once bid higher than Rufen or say weiter. Contracts low to high: Rufen, Treiben, Neid-Spiel/Trumpf, Durch, Trumpf-Durch. If all pass, Rufen is played. In Rufen forehand calls a non-trump card he does not hold; holder becomes partner. In Treiben/Trumpf soloist vs three; in Treiben soloist chooses trumps, in Trumpf dealer upcard is trump. In Durch/Trumpf-Durch declarer must take all 8 tricks, with no trump in Durch. Before first lead teams may raise stakes with Schuss, Re etc. Play: trump Matzl special bonus. Lead: declarer in Durch, otherwise forehand. Must follow suit, must head trick if able, must trump/overtrump if void (Farb-, Trumpf-, Stichzwang). Highest trump or highest of led suit wins trick and leads next. Points: Sow 11, Ten 10, King 4, Ober 3, Unter 2 plus 10 for last trick =130 total. 66+ wins; <30 no water, 0 tricks no trick. Capturing opponent's trump Ten absolves loss payment, winning game after that gives extra point.
